piezas.titulo: Written production: Food and simple orders
texto: Guided writing for placing a food order: write a short note or message asking for food. Structure: «ขอ» + [Food] + [condition: ไม่เผ็ด] + [polite particle]. Write well-formed sentences without separating the syllables.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «เครื่องดื่มสมุนไพรและน้ำผลไม้ช่วยดับความเผ็ดร้อนของอาหารไทยได้ดี» express?

opciones.texto: Herbal drinks and fruit juices effectively relieve the heat of spicy food.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «เครื่องดื่มสมุนไพรและน้ำผลไม้ช่วยดับความเผ็ดร้อนของอาหารไทยได้ดี» from the text.

opciones.texto: Serving shared dishes in the middle of the table reflects social generosity.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the text, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Thai cuisine is famous for its variety of flavours and fresh ingredients.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
